'''2000 DragonCon Team Event''' was a Star Wars CCG team held in DragonCon, Atlanta, Georgia on 1 July 2000. Smells Like Fish, Tastes Like Chicken (team: [[Clint Hays]], [[Bill Gordon]], [[Jim Sells]] and others) won it. It is known from Walter Cowart's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d962">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-dragoncon-by-walterd962/ dragoncon-by-walter], DeckTech (Walter "Walter" Cowart, 2 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-dragoncon-by-walterd962/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 DragonCon Open]].

* '''Date:''' 1 July 2000
* '''Site:''' DragonCon, Atlanta, Georgia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' Smells Like Fish, Tastes Like Chicken (team: [[Clint Hays]], [[Bill Gordon]], [[Jim Sells]] and others)
